=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:4117-4131 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The merge_with_followup red-head branch writes only `judge_skip_reason=final_ci_repair_requested|final_ci_handover|final_ci_handover_posted` and leaves `judge_handled=false` (the default at line 1037). As a result, "Post review-blocked comment on PR (autofix exhaustion)" (.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5259) runs when max_iterations_reached=true and falls to the `*)` arm (scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:95-99). That arm posts the generic "AI review/autofix blocked — needs human intervention" comment with the `ai:autofix-cap-head:v1` latch.
  WHY: The comment contradicts the judge's repair request or hand-over, has no per-head dedupe so it reposts on every later judge run, and is posted with GH_PAT containing "AI review/autofix". The gate's terminal same-head pre-filter (scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:495, 615-619 `not review_output_at > final_at`) then skips the dispatched repair run as terminal_same_head, so the repair never runs. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5860 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When the final-CI repair caps are exhausted (`RB_MERGE_STATUS=final_ci_handover`), the autofix-exhaustion comment step does not skip, which leads to redundant comments.
  WHY: The step posts a generic "needs human intervention" comment with an `ai:autofix-cap-head:v1` latch. That contradicts the requested hand-over comment and causes duplicate review-blocked comments on every later judge run.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:4118 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the switch is off or holds an unrecognized value, `[ "$(rb_judge_red_check_switch 2>/dev/null)" = "true" ]` short-circuits. No `RB_JUDGE_RED_CHECK ... outcome=disabled mode=merge_with_followup` line is logged, and `2>/dev/null` swallows the switch's `::warning::`.
  WHY: This is a greppable-log gap, not a runtime failure. It drifts from the contractual log registry (agents.d/10063-red-final-ci-judge-repair.md), so switch-off behavior on this path looks the same as a pending-checks stall.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

When the snapshot is missing, disabled, for another head, or unrenderable, the renderer leaves the names file empty. `rb_judge_red_check_failure_list` then falls back to "- the failed job names could not be read for this head (see the PR's checks)", and the alert falls back to `${JUDGE_CI_FAILURE_SUMMARY:-see the PR checks}` (.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5963-5966, 6018-6021). There is no fallback fetch of failed job or test names, and test_red_check_hands_over_when_the_caps_are_used_up only exercises the snapshot-present case. === FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:4117-4131 (with .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5259 and scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:31-99) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The red-head merge_with_followup branch writes only `judge_skip_reason=${_rb_mwf_red_status}` and never `judge_handled=true` (the default false is at line 1037). The exhaustion step therefore posts the generic autofix-cap comment through the `*)` arm, with `AUTOFIX_CAP_HEAD_LATCH="true"`. It appears as a contradicting second comment after final_ci_repair_requested, as a second hand-over comment after final_ci_handover, and it reposts with no dedupe throughout the 180-minute in-flight window.
  WHY: The GH_PAT comment containing "AI review/autofix" counts as review output in the gate (review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:495 and 615-619: `not review_output_at > final_at`). The dispatched repair run is skipped as terminal same-head, and after 180 minutes the next judge run hands over with reason=head_requested. Minimal fix: add `&& !contains(fromJSON('["final_ci_repair_requested","final_ci_handover","final_ci_handover_posted"]'), steps.rb_judge.outputs.judge_skip_reason)` to the `if:` at review_autofix.yml:5259, or add a no-post arm to the step script's case.

There is no fallback read, and the case is rare.

- HARDENING: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml line 5259 `if:`: add the `!contains(fromJSON([...final_ci_*...]), steps.rb_judge.outputs.judge_skip_reason)` guard (1 line).

Call `rb_judge_red_check_log disabled "mode=merge_with_followup"` or drop `2>/dev/null` (2-3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
